purpose: Twelfth unmapped quality-first reserve, deepening cryptids/anomalous zoology, documented and disputed UFO case narratives, remote viewing/ESP/psychical research, secret or withheld technology, and time/parallel-world/reality-manipulation material for later KFB deck/world/multiverse mapping.
sourcePolicy: Research reserve only. Preserve transitions between rumor, eyewitness report, specimen, official record, experiment, critique, fiction, prediction and later explanation. Inclusion records historically interesting source material; it does not imply endorsement or equal evidentiary weight.
mappingPolicy: UNMAPPED_BY_DESIGN. Do not invent deck/card/island/billboard/world/multiverse assignments during collection.

rotationIntent.goal: Extend the weird-history and speculative-science reserve with cases where the same subject can move between monster lore and zoology, UFO report and classified-program explanation, psi claim and operational critique, secret research and public disclosure, or fiction/metaphysics and models of time.
rotationIntent.note: No runtime selector, truth classifier, world mapping or public approval is changed.
